about: The door at 105 as an examination (REDESIGN.md Phase 14, docs/NARRATIVE.md §13.7): the Yakṣa's questions, Mahābhārata, Āraṇyaka Parvan. One per vice a debt holds (the seed's holds square). q is asked, a is the canonical answer. heals is the ladder whose climb, after the debt was planted, lets the book answer it, and answered says that climb, after {name}. Greed and anger heal by Phase 4's pairs (43 → 44, 50 → 51); the other four by the door alone (decided 26 Oct). All six are the text's own, checked against Ganguli's translation (Vana Parva, Section CCCXI): truth is the highest refuge of heaven; idleness consists in not discharging one's duties; desire, if renounced, maketh one wealthy; it is from avarice that friends are forsaken; anger is an invincible enemy; pride, if renounced, maketh one agreeable. 'What is poison?' is answered 'a request' in the text, not desire (corrected 26 Oct).

q.hi: स्वर्ग का परम आश्रय क्या है?

answered.en: told the truth about the homework, in front of everyone
answered.hi: ने सबके सामने गृहकार्य के बारे में सच कहा था

answered.en: waited three days outside an office for an answer
answered.hi: एक जवाब के लिए तीन दिन एक दफ़्तर के बाहर {बैठा रहा था|बैठी रही थी}

q.en: What, if renounced, makes one wealthy?
q.hi: क्या त्यागकर मनुष्य धनी होता है?

answered.en: asked, when everything was being divided, what any of it was for
answered.hi: ने सब कुछ बँटते समय पूछा था कि यह सब किसलिए है

q.hi: मित्र क्यों छोड़ दिए जाते हैं?

answered.hi: ने अच्छा वाला कंबल दे दिया था

answered.en: sat up all night with a neighbour's sick child
answered.hi: पड़ोसी के बीमार बच्चे के पास रात भर {जागता रहा था|जागती रही थी}

q.en: What, given up, makes one liked by all?
q.hi: क्या त्यागकर मनुष्य सबका प्रिय होता है?

answered.en: stood in the rain over the books because the teacher had asked
answered.hi: गुरु के कहने पर बारिश में किताबों पर {झुका खड़ा रहा था|झुकी खड़ी रही थी}
